 Coram:

Order
Order No. 11.11.2024
 02. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual  /Physical Mode).
2.

This bail application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. of the petitioner has arisen out of G.R. Case No.616 of 2023 in connection of Jeypore Sadar P.S. Case No.168 of 2023 corresponding to T.R. Case No.51 of 2024 pending in the court of learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Jeypore.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that, the petitioner has been implicated with the offences under Sections 366/376(2)(n)/498A/305 of I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act,
2012.
4.

It is settled propositions of law under Rule-4, Sub-rule-13 and 15(viii) of the POCSO Rules 2020,
no bail application of the petitioner shall be heard without giving notice to the victim or informant.
5. Here, in this case, the informant is the sister of the victim.

Therefore, learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the bail application on the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State for transmission of the same to the informant for her appearance before this Court on the next date of hearing of the bail application by giving opportunity of being heard to her.
This direction should be complied by the learned counsel for the petitioner within two days.

6. List this matter on 04.12.2024 for hearing of the same.
7.

Learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State is directed to collect the up-to-date case diary and charge-sheet, if any, in the meantime and to apprise about the same at the time of hearing of the bail application.
